core.title: Encode Smart WiFi Deadbolt with Century Trim, Schlage BE489WB-CEN
tags: Encode Smart WiFi Deadbolt with Century Trim

text.description_html:
Schlage BE489WB-CEN Century Encode Smart WiFi Deadbolt

Built-in WiFi allows you to lock/unlock from anywhere, plus set up guest access codes for recurring, temporary or permanent access when paired with the Schlage Home app or Key by Amazon app, no additional accessories required. For additional convenience, enjoy voice commands via Alexa or Google Assistant. Create and manage up to 100 access codes for trusted friends and family to use with the fingerprint-resistant, capacitive touchscreen with easy one-touch locking. Built-in alarm technology senses potential security breaches at the lock. Low battery indicator offers weeks of advanced warning for battery replacement. Easy to install with just a screwdriver. Unique Snap n Stay technology snaps the deadbolt onto the door so both hands are free during installation. Will fit most standard doors (1-3/8 inches to 1-3/4 inches door thicknesses and 2-3/8 inches or 2-3/4 inches backsets). The Encode Smart WiFi Deadbolt with Century Trim works with Schlage Home, Key by Amazon, Alexa, Ring, and Google Assistant.

The deadbolt is operated by a keypad or key on the exterior side, and by a thumb turn on the inside.

Features of the Schlage Touch Pad Deadbolt:

  • ANSI/BHMI Grade 1
  • ADA Compliant
  • Uses 4 AA alkaline batteries.
  • Keying: 5-pin tumbler, C Keyway, 1 key included
  • Operating Temperatures: Outside escutcheon: -35C to 66C,Inside escutcheon: -10C to 49C
  • WiFi compatibility: requires 2.4GHz WiFi networkCodes: Pre-set, unique 6-digit programming code, two pre-set unique 4-digit access codes, 100 code capacity

Specifications for the Century Encode Smart WiFi Deadboltt:

  • Outside Plate Width: 3"
  • Outside Plate Height: 5"
  • Inside Plate Width: 3"
  • Inside Plate Height: 5-1/2"
  • Inside Plate Projection: 2.2"
  • Adjustable Backset for both 2-3/8" or 2-3/4"
  • Door Thickness: 1-3/8" to 1-3/4"
  • Fits 2-1/8" Crossbore Hole (Standard Pre-Drilled Door)

Sold Individually
